entries.zh: 脾胃火（中医谓脾胃有火、内热炽盛）
entries.en: fire/heat of the spleen and stomach (excess internal heat in Chinese medicine)
entries.notes: 西头词「Bacomuy cald.」（cald.=caliente，很热）显系闽南语「脾胃」之记音与「火＝热」意译的杂糅，与汉字栏正合。

entries.en: spleen and stomach strong, robust (healthy digestion)
entries.notes: 西头词「Baco fuerte」同上条体例：「Baco」记「脾胃」之音、「fuerte」译「壮」，四栏义合。

entries.zh: 拐杖；手杖（西语 báculo）；西注又作「地狱之剑」，此义未明
entries.en: staff, crutch (báculo); the Spanish head also gives 'sword of hell', an unexplained secondary sense
entries.notes: 「Spada del inferno」与汉字栏的对应关系未明，且 M 栏「quiam cuay」有删划，故主义取 báculo＝拐杖，次义存而不断。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（互见条：见 Cordón — báculo「地狱之剑」；字面作「釋拐」）
entries.en: damaged cross-reference entry: 'see Cordón — báculo, sword of hell'; literal characters only, gloss undetermined
entries.notes: M 栏整句删划且删划范围待核，仅余西语互见指示与「釋拐」二字，语义无法定夺。
「Bada」为马来语 badak（犀牛），马尼拉贸易语境常见借词，与汉字「犀」正合。

entries.en: clapper of a bell; bell hammer

entries.zh: 糠粕（糠粃、渣滓；西注特指榨汁后嚼剩之蔗渣）
entries.en: chaff and dregs; glossed as the chewed-out, pressed remains of sugarcane after the juice is extracted (bagasse)
entries.notes: 「朴」疑为「粕」（压榨残渣）之写法；M 栏首字难辨并有删划，西头词后半讹乱，义据汉字栏与西注大意推定。

entries.zh: 拗陰（首字[疑]拗/执，语义无法定夺，释义存疑）
entries.en: '— yin' (second character = yin, i.e. shade/female/genitals); compound sense undetermined
entries.notes: 汉字首字有[疑]，四栏音义均无从确解，西头词 Bahague 亦非通行西语词，故只照录字面。

entries.zh: 喝（此处当「呵」用）：用口呵出热气（如对热食吹气）
entries.en: to breathe hot air out with the mouth; to blow on (hot food or drink)
entries.notes: 汉字「喝」此处借作「呵」，据西注明言 aire caliente con la boca（用口呵热气）定义。

entries.en: to breathe out hot air; hot breath blown from the mouth

entries.zh: 落（落下、下降；亦指使降低）
entries.en: to descend, go down; to lower
to lower it down; to set down low

entries.zh: 落去（下去）；第三字[疑]，全词义待考
entries.en: to go down; final character uncertain, full compound meaning unsettled
entries.notes: 汉字第三字[疑]叩/叱，M 栏并见残断字样，仅「落去＝下去」一义可确定。
